description: A publisher needs a grayscale version of a painting for a black-and-white print edition. Open the color image /home/ga/Documents/krita/water_lilies.png in Krita. Convert the image to grayscale using Image > Convert Image Color Space, selecting 'Grayscale' as the color model. Then export the result as a PNG to /home/ga/Documents/exports/water_lilies_grayscale.png.
